correctness.rationale: For independent shortest vectors a,b the inequalities |a±b|≥L give |cos θ|≤1/2. Any missing lattice coset has centered coordinates s,t∈[-1/2,1/2] with |sa+tb|²≤3L²/4, so a,b generate Λ. The two translates Λ and (a+b)/2+Λ form a rectangular index-two superlattice generated by u=(a+b)/2,v=(a−b)/2, with u·v=0, |u|²+|v|²=L²; its Voronoi rectangle gives upper covering radius L/2 and exactly [a/2],[b/2] farthest points modulo Λ. For r<L/2 the torus r-balls embed as disks: two such contractible opens cannot cover a T² with nonzero H¹ cup product, proving the unrestricted lower bound. Euclidean area L²sin θ gives density π/(2sin θ) and square/hexagonal extrema. Translate arbitrary two sites to inverse pairs to prove pillowcase radius; square and hexagonal endpoints checked. Independent exact Gram computations at five rational cosines and farthest corners corroborate only finite samples.
